description: This file defines the ReadFileTool class, a tool for reading and processing files within a project. It includes methods for parsing parameters, executing file reads with support for line ranges, binary files, and image files, as well as handling user permissions and context token budgets.

classes.name: ReadFileTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool, responsible for reading files with support for line ranges, binary formats, images, and user permissions, with detailed handling of context token budgets and output formatting.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters to extract file entries with optional line ranges.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to process file entries: reads files, handles binary and image files, applies line ranges, manages user permissions, and formats output.

methods.name: getReadFileToolDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for the tool usage based on provided parameters, including file paths and line ranges.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial tool invocation, extracting file path from parameters and prompting user confirmation.
